entry_item.definition: 1 n. Furrow between two fields, border, boundary; frontier; limitation.

example.definition: Situated on or near the frontier, marginal.
Border marker usually consisting of a pile of stones.
Frontier of a country, borderland, marginal region.

entry_item.definition: 3 n. Bow of a musical instrument; violin (cf. kikili); also a musical instrument known as morin xuyur (see under xuγur ).

1 ligne, trait, limite, borne, raie (entre deux champs):
2 un archet (de violon).

example.definition: tracer les limites de, enfermer dans des limites, délimiter

entry_item.definition: n. A border, a boundary. A landmark
To erect boundary or landmarks. To mark a boundary.
